subject: Converting Shiny UI to HTML5 UI

messages.author: ca279b85ad7d8cd4
messages.subject: Converting Shiny UI to HTML5 UI
parts: Is there a tool to convert a Studio R Shiny UI to an HTML5 Java based UI?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Converting Shiny UI to HTML5 UI
parts:
There is no "tool" that I know of but it can be achieved (for most simple apps).

The steps are as follows
  • In Chrome right click and then click on View page source (perhaps other users can help fill in this step for other browsers)
  • Copy the content of the newly opened page into the file www/index.html
  • Remove your ui.R (or rename it to something else for backup purposes)
  • Now your folder structure should look like
    • server.R
    • www
      • index.html
  • Run your Shiny app using runApp(...) as you normally would.
